challenge.method: Compare the exact printed record number and date with the March 1968 MR 93 title leaf and the cover of the Revised Report.
challenge.results: The three documents carry different report labels. The MR 101 wording identifies a second printing of the original report and supplies no evidence of a separately revised language.

limitations: The title leaf supports the bibliographic witness for the entity as scoped. Printing sequence is a separate fact from edition-level semantics.
